description: The Mikenas-Carls is the English's sharpest weapon: White grabs space with e4 and e5, and Black counterattacks in the center with ...d5-d4. The result is an imbalanced, tactical struggle where White's shattered queenside pawns are compensated by the bishop pair and central control.

lines.description: After 1.c4 Nf6 2.Nc3 e6, White seizes space with 3.e4 and Black immediately challenges with 3...d5. White pushes 4.e5 and Black sacrifices a pawn with 4...d4, attacking the knight. After 5.exf6 dxc3 6.bxc3 Qxf6, White has the bishop pair and a central pawn mass against Black's better structure. Both sides must play energetically — White to exploit the bishops, Black to blockade and attack the weak pawns.
